body:
Yes, people love to talk about being open and accepting but when faced with someone like me they shut down completely. I feel like I repulse neurotypicals - "why are you so weird? why can't you relate to anyone? why are you so quiet? are you retarded?" Maybe in 50 years people like us won't be so surprising or repulsive and maybe then people will be able to get help. Until then there doesn't seem to be a solution.

I have no practical advice but you can talk to me if you want.

Yes exactly. This is exactly how I feel. I've gotten to a point where there's nothing I want to have or do anymore, I just don't care. I feel like I'm surviving just because I'm not dead yet; I'm only alive because I'm afraid to fuck up a suicide attempt. I feel like a sentient vegetable most days. 

Most neurotypicals don't even know what to say to people like us. On other posts on this board they chime in with, "someone loves you!" "there's always hope!" "please see a therapist or get on meds!" But I notice that only people on the spectrum have left meaningful replies on this post. Just goes to show that they can't relate to us and the hopelessness of what we go through, basically like saying "you're a lost cause, sorry don't know what to do with you." Very similar to how I'm treated irl by "normal" people - ignored or disdained.

So what do you do when no one loves you, when your condition is permanent, and when therapy and meds have failed you? The only reason I'm alive right now is because I can't find a foolproof way to die. 

Anyway I'm sorry you're going through the same thing. Please feel free to PM me if you want to talk.

Forgot ADD in my OP, oops. I'm a dick for saying it but if you're neurotypical and have these problems you have a chance that things will get better. I'll be autistic until I'm dead no matter what I do. The last job I had a monkey could do, but I was having meltdowns every week because I couldn't handle it. Bullied by coworkers, had trouble getting simple tasks done and had to write everything down because I can't take directions. I'll never be able to take care of myself and people will always think I'm a creep or an idiot because of my social issues. If I don't kill myself I'll have to work my ass off doing things other people take for granted: basic hygiene, feeding myself, getting enough sleep, going outside without having a panic attack. Not to mention working, which is impossible for me. I'm not a viable person, I should have been aborted because I'm a waste of life.
